scripts/data_prep/collect_data_lake.py.name: Download open datasets
scripts/data_prep/collect_data_lake.py.description: Downloads the public datasets on AI and work, such as the Anthropic and TechWolf data, and keeps a copy.

scripts/data_prep/collect_external_data..name: Download skills and company data
scripts/data_prep/collect_external_data..description: Fetches skill, occupation and company data from public sources and adds a company-type label from the Jev model.

scripts/data_prep/export_csv_chunks.py.name: Split the clean data
scripts/data_prep/export_csv_chunks.py.description: Splits the cleaned vacancy data into CSV files small enough for GitHub.

scripts/data_prep/generate_synthetic_dat.name: Make the demo company
scripts/data_prep/generate_synthetic_dat.description: Creates the made-up company data for Northwind Bank: its teams, jobs, people and AI usage.

scripts/data_prep/inspect_parquet.py.name: Inspect the vacancy files
scripts/data_prep/inspect_parquet.py.description: Reads the hackathon vacancy files and lists their columns, row counts and missing values.

scripts/data_prep/prepare_text_export.py.name: Clean the vacancy text
scripts/data_prep/prepare_text_export.py.description: Removes HTML tags and odd characters from the vacancy titles and descriptions, so the text is readable.

scripts/data_prep/prepare_vacancies.py.name: Combine the vacancy files
scripts/data_prep/prepare_vacancies.py.description: Puts all the yearly vacancy files together in one table and keeps the original values.

scripts/data_prep/run_pipeline.py.name: Run the whole data preparation
scripts/data_prep/run_pipeline.py.description: Runs the data preparation steps in order, from the raw files to the checked result.

scripts/data_prep/validate_data.py.name: Check the prepared data
scripts/data_prep/validate_data.py.description: Checks the prepared files for missing values, duplicates and row counts.
